notes: Factual values in our own schema; no source page artwork or prose is shipped.
Standard atomic weights are dimensionless; intervals and parenthetical uncertainties are retained.
Bracketed integer values are isotope mass numbers, not atomic masses or standard atomic weights.
Multiple bracketed isotope numbers retain CIAAW alternative entries instead of choosing a unique longest-lived isotope.
Electron configurations are reference assignments; explicit calculated/predicted source qualifiers are retained.
Lawrencium uses the current NIST 7p assignment rather than the older PubChem 6d assignment.
Shell populations are derived by expanding noble-gas cores and summing orbitals with the same principal quantum number.
